purpose: Define a federated query plan as an explicit derived execution plan over exact per-origin query fragments and combination operators, separate from the canonical query definition.

topics.name: DWH Federated Query Plan
topics.purpose: Define a federated query plan as an explicit derived execution plan over exact per-origin query fragments and combination operators, separate from the canonical query definition.

semantics.definition_rule: Canonical query definition remains distinct from derived federated execution plan.
semantics.plan_rule: Plan identifies exact participating source identities and per-source query fragments.
semantics.combine_rule: Cross-source join/union/aggregation operations are explicit plan nodes.
semantics.capability_rule: Plan respects each source's declared query capabilities and schema compatibility.
semantics.optimization_rule: Optimizer may choose among semantically equivalent plans but cannot change query semantics or governance.
semantics.identity_rule: Plan/execution identity is distinct from source, query definition and result-set identity.
semantics.provenance_rule: Result lineage records which plan/source fragments contributed.
semantics.authority_rule: Planning does not grant source access.

invariants.rule: Federated DWH access preserves each origin's exact identity, schema, governance, lineage and consistency evidence; combining results never centralizes semantic ownership or silently expands authorization.

hard_gates.condition: query plan silently changes query semantics
source chosen by nearest/fastest endpoint without explicit identity
cross-source operator inferred only from UI graph

references.purpose: Federated plan derives from exact query semantics.
